```{r Data preparation}
#install.packages("gllvm")
library(gllvm)
library(dplyr)
#library(tidyverse)
set.seed(0)
data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]
df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
    dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))
```


```{r running gllvm 1 l.v.}
# Function to fit generating ('true') GLLVM model and obtain fitted conditional mean values
model_and_pred = function(Y, X, l.v.){
  # Fit Poisson GLLVM using Laplace Approximation
  # Y = n x J responses
  # X = n x p environmental covariates
  # l.v. = no. of latent variables
  true_model = gllvm(Y, X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA", gradient.check = TRUE)
  # Obtain fitted conditional response means, including contribution from predicted latent variables
  pred_counts = predict(true_model, type = 'response', lv.pred=TRUE)
  #Return original data, fitted generating model, fitted conditional means
  return(list(Y = Y, X = X, true_model = true_model, pred_counts = pred_counts))
}

# No. of simulated datasets
B = 100

# Generating model with 1 latent variable
# Fit original microbial dataset with 1 l.v.

#model_pred = model_and_pred(Y = microbial[, 1:200], X = as.matrix(scale(Xenv[, 1:2])), l.v. = 1) 
#save(model_pred, file = "model_pred.RDATA")
load("model_pred.RDATA")

# Generate B simulated datasets conditionally on l.v. from fitted generating model
# Simulations stored as stacked 56 x 200 datasets

#sim_counts_all = simulate(model_pred$true_model, nsim = B, conditional = TRUE) #turn into 3D array 
#sim_counts_all = array(sim_counts_all, dim = c(nRow = 56, nsim = B, nVar = 200))

#save(sim_counts_all, file = "sim_counts_all.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# Create folder where fitted gllvms are stored
dir.create("gllvm_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
# Storage for simulation results
time_all_gllvm1 = rep(NA, B) #fitting time for each of the simulations
KL_all_gllvm1 = rep(NA, B) #KL divergence between generating conditional means and fitted conditional means
loglik_new_all_gllvm1 = rep(NA, B) #conditional Poisson log-likelihood

# Environmental covariated used in each fitted model
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
# No. of l.v.
l.v. = 1
set.seed(0)

# Refit gllvm with 1 l.v. to each simulated dataset
for (k in 1:B){
  time_i = system.time({
    gllvm_sim_1 = gllvm(y = sim_counts_all[, k, ], X = X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")}) 
  
  # Save fitted GLLVM from each simulation 
  save(gllvm_sim_1, file = file.path("gllvm_models", paste0("gllvm_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))

  # Conditional means from original generating model
  true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts
  
  # Obtain fitted Poisson conditional means from refitted model
  pred_mu = predict(gllvm_sim_1, type = 'response', lv.pred = TRUE) #account for latent variable
  
  mu = pred_mu
  
  # 'log(mu)'
  eta = predict(gllvm_sim_1, type = 'link', lv.pred = TRUE) 
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))

  # Store summary quantities
  time_all_gllvm1[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  KL_all_gllvm1[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_gllvm1[k] = sum(dpois(sim_counts_all[ , k, ], lambda = mu, log = TRUE)) # treats u as fixed parameters 
#  loglik_builtin_all_gllvm1[k] = gllvm_sim_1$logL #treats u as latent variables where integral needs to be marginalised over u
}

# Mean, standard deviation of fitting time
time_int_gllvm1 = c(mean(time_all_gllvm1, na.rm = TRUE), sqrt(var(time_all_gllvm1, na.rm = TRUE)))
# Mean, standard deviation of KL divergence
KL_int_gllvm1 = c(mean(KL_all_gllvm1, na.rm = TRUE), sqrt(var(KL_all_gllvm1, na.rm = TRUE)))

save(time_all_gllvm1, KL_all_gllvm1, loglik_new_all_gllvm1, time_int_gllvm1, KL_int_gllvm1, file = file.path("gllvm_models", "gllvm1_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("gllvm_models", "gllvm1_summary.RDATA"))
time_all_gllvm1
KL_all_gllvm1
loglik_new_all_gllvm1
time_int_gllvm1
KL_int_gllvm1
```

```{r alternating glms using 1 l.v.}
# Number of simulated datasets
B = 100

# Load fitted generating model, B simulated datasets as conacatenated 56 x 200 blocks
load("model_pred.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# KL divergence should be outside
# Fit alt_glm to B simulated datasets
dir.create("glm_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
source("alt_glm.R")

time_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){ #start here for function - input Y, X
  glm_sim_1 = try(alt_glm(sim_counts = sim_counts_all[ , k, ], X = X, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), N = 100), silent = TRUE)
  
    if (inherits(glm_sim_1, "try-error")) {
  cat("Simulation", k, "failed:\n",
      as.character(glm_sim_1),
      "\n")
    ite_converge_all_glm1[k] = NA
    time_all_glm1[k] = NA
    KL_all_glm1[k] = NA
    loglik_new_all_glm1[k] = NA
    
    next
    }
    
  save(glm_sim_1, file = file.path("glm_models", paste0("glm_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))
  true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts
  pred_mu = glm_sim_1$pred_counts
  eta = glm_sim_1$eta
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))
  # Store summary quantities
  ite_converge_all_glm1[k] = glm_sim_1$ite_converge
  time_all_glm1[k] = glm_sim_1$time
  KL_all_glm1[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_glm1[k] = glm_sim_1$loglik_new
}

# Mean, standard deviation across simulations
time_int_glm1 = c(mean(time_all_glm1, na.rm = TRUE), sqrt(var(time_all_glm1, na.rm = TRUE)))
KL_int_glm1 = c(mean(KL_all_glm1, na.rm = TRUE), sqrt(var(KL_all_glm1, na.rm = TRUE)))

#way of storing each model -- use debugger after lik

save(time_all_glm1, KL_all_glm1, ite_converge_all_glm1, loglik_new_all_glm1, time_int_glm1, KL_int_glm1, file = file.path("glm_models", "glm1_summary.RDATA"))

load(file.path("glm_models", "glm1_summary.RDATA"))
time_all_glm1
KL_all_glm1
ite_converge_all_glm1
loglik_new_all_glm1
time_int_glm1
KL_int_glm1
```

```{r alternating glms, 1 l.v. updating through constraints -- Chen}

B = 100

# Load generating model, simulated datasets

for (k in 1:B){
  jmle_sim_1 = lv_chen(sim_counts = sim_counts_all[ , k, ], X = X, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), K = ncol(sim_counts), N = 1000)
  
  save(jmle_sim_1, file = file.path("jmle_models", paste0("jmle_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))
  
  true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts

  eta = jmle_sim_1$eta

  # Store summary quantities

  time_all_jmle1[k] = jmle_sim_1$time
  KL_all_jmle1[k] = KL

}  

# Mean, standard deviation across simulations

save(time_all_jmle1, KL_all_jmle1, ite_converge_all_jmle1, loglik_new_all_jmle1, time_int_jmle1, KL_int_jmle1, file = file.path("jmle_models", "jmle1_summary.RDATA"))
```

```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda and u using 1 l.v.}
B = 100
library(glmnet)
# Load generating model, simulated datasets
load("model_pred.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# Fit pen_glm to B simulated datasets
dir.create("glmnet_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
source("pen_glm.R")

time_all_glmnet1 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_glmnet1 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_glmnet1 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_glmnet1 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){ 
  glmnet_sim_1 = try(pen_glm(sim_counts = sim_counts_all[ , k, ], X = X, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), N = 200), silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(glmnet_sim_1, "try-error")) {
  cat("Simulation", k, "failed:\n",
      as.character(glmnet_sim_1),
      "\n")
    ite_converge_all_glmnet1[k] = NA
    time_all_glmnet1[k] = NA
    KL_all_glmnet1[k] = NA
    loglik_new_all_glmnet1[k] = NA
    
    next
  }
  
  save(glmnet_sim_1, file = file.path("glmnet_models", paste0("glmnet_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))

  true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts
  pred_mu = glmnet_sim_1$pred_counts
  eta = glmnet_sim_1$eta
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))

  ite_converge_all_glmnet1[k] = glmnet_sim_1$ite_converge
  time_all_glmnet1[k] = glmnet_sim_1$time
  KL_all_glmnet1[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_glmnet1[k] = glmnet_sim_1$loglik_new
}

# Mean, standard deviation across simulations
time_int_glmnet1 = c(mean(time_all_glmnet1, na.rm = TRUE), sqrt(var(time_all_glmnet1, na.rm = TRUE)))
KL_int_glmnet1 = c(mean(KL_all_glmnet1, na.rm = TRUE), sqrt(var(KL_all_glmnet1, na.rm = TRUE)))

save(time_all_glmnet1, KL_all_glmnet1, ite_converge_all_glmnet1, loglik_new_all_glmnet1, time_int_glmnet1, KL_int_glmnet1, file = file.path("glmnet_models", "glmnet1_summary.RDATA"))

load(file.path("glmnet_models", "glmnet1_summary.RDATA"))
time_all_glmnet1
KL_all_glmnet1
ite_converge_all_glmnet1
loglik_new_all_glmnet1
time_int_glmnet1
KL_int_glmnet1
```

```{r glmnet_maxit - penalty on lambda and u using 1 l.v.}
B = 100
library(glmnet)
# Load generating model, simulated datasets
load("model_pred.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# Fit pen_glm to B simulated datasets
dir.create("glmnet_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
source("pen_glm_maxit.R")

time_all_glmnet_maxit1 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_glmnet_maxit1 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_glmnet_maxit1 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_glmnet_maxit1 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){ 
  glmnet_maxit_sim_1 = try(pen_glm_maxit(sim_counts = sim_counts_all[ , k, ], X = X, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), N = 200), silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(glmnet_maxit_sim_1, "try-error")) {
  cat("Simulation", k, "failed:\n",
      as.character(glmnet_maxit_sim_1),
      "\n")
    ite_converge_all_glmnet_maxit1[k] = NA
    time_all_glmnet_maxit1[k] = NA
    KL_all_glmnet_maxit1[k] = NA
    loglik_new_all_glmnet_maxit1[k] = NA
    
    next
  }
  
  save(glmnet_maxit_sim_1, file = file.path("glmnet_models", paste0("glmnet_maxit_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))

  true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts
  pred_mu = glmnet_maxit_sim_1$pred_counts
  eta = glmnet_maxit_sim_1$eta
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))

  ite_converge_all_glmnet_maxit1[k] = glmnet_maxit_sim_1$ite_converge
  time_all_glmnet_maxit1[k] = glmnet_maxit_sim_1$time
  KL_all_glmnet_maxit1[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_glmnet_maxit1[k] = glmnet_maxit_sim_1$loglik_new
}

# Mean, standard deviation across simulations
time_int_glmnet_maxit1 = c(mean(time_all_glmnet_maxit1, na.rm = TRUE), sqrt(var(time_all_glmnet_maxit1, na.rm = TRUE)))
KL_int_glmnet_maxit1 = c(mean(KL_all_glmnet_maxit1, na.rm = TRUE), sqrt(var(KL_all_glmnet_maxit1, na.rm = TRUE)))

save(time_all_glmnet_maxit1, KL_all_glmnet_maxit1, ite_converge_all_glmnet_maxit1, loglik_new_all_glmnet_maxit1, time_int_glmnet_maxit1, KL_int_glmnet_maxit1, file = file.path("glmnet_models", "glmnet_maxit1_summary.RDATA"))

load(file.path("glmnet_models", "glmnet_maxit1_summary.RDATA"))
time_all_glmnet_maxit1
KL_all_glmnet_maxit1
ite_converge_all_glmnet_maxit1
loglik_new_all_glmnet_maxit1
time_int_glmnet_maxit1
KL_int_glmnet_maxit1
```


```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda and u using 2 l.v. Error: inner loop 3; cannot correct step size at k = 7}
# Generating model with 2 latent variables

load("model_pred_2.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all_2.RDATA")

time_all_glmnet_maxit2 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_glmnet_maxit2 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_glmnet_maxit2 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_glmnet_maxit2 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
set.seed(0)

for (k in 1:B){#'try' fitting for the dataset, dont simulate another dataset if statement: iter_converge_all = NA, etc. otherwise keep going for other datasets
  glmnet_maxit_sim_2 = try(pen_glm_maxit(sim_counts = sim_counts_all_2[ , k, ], X = X, u = mvrnorm(n = 56, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, ncol = 2)), N = 400), silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(glmnet_maxit_sim_2, "try-error")) {
    cat("Simulation", k, "failed:\n",
        as.character(glmnet_maxit_sim_2),
        "\n")
      ite_converge_all_glmnet_maxit2[k] = NA
      time_all_glmnet_maxit2[k] = NA
      KL_all_glmnet_maxit2[k] = NA
      loglik_new_all_glmnet_maxit2[k] = NA
      
      next
      }
  
  save(glmnet_maxit_sim_2, file = file.path("glmnet_models", paste0("glmnet_maxit_sim_2_", k, ".RDATA")))

  true_mu = model_pred_2$pred_counts
  pred_mu = glmnet_maxit_sim_2$pred_counts
  eta = glmnet_maxit_sim_2$eta
  KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_mu))
 
  ite_converge_all_glmnet_maxit2[k] = glmnet_maxit_sim_2$ite_converge
  time_all_glmnet_maxit2[k] = glmnet_maxit_sim_2$time
  KL_all_glmnet_maxit2[k] = KL
  loglik_new_all_glmnet_maxit2[k] = glmnet_maxit_sim_2$loglik_new
}

time_int_glmnet_maxit2 = c(mean(time_all_glmnet_maxit2, na.rm = TRUE), sqrt(var(time_all_glmnet_maxit2, na.rm = TRUE)))
KL_int_glmnet_maxit2 = c(mean(KL_all_glmnet_maxit2, na.rm = TRUE), sqrt(var(KL_all_glmnet_maxit2, na.rm = TRUE)))

save(time_all_glmnet_maxit2, KL_all_glmnet_maxit2, ite_converge_all_glmnet_maxit2, loglik_new_all_glmnet_maxit2, time_int_glmnet_maxit2, KL_int_glmnet_maxit2, file = file.path("glmnet_models", "glmnet_maxit2_summary.RDATA"))
```

```{r Plotting}
library(ggplot2)
B = 100
Y = microbial[, 1:200]

load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all_2.RDATA")

load(file.path("gllvm_models", "gllvm1_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("gllvm_models", "gllvm2_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("glm_models", "glm1_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("glm_models", "glm2_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("jmle_models", "jmle1_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("jmle_models", "jmle2_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("glmnet_models", "glmnet1_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("glmnet_models", "glmnet2_summary.RDATA"))

df = data.frame(method = factor(rep(c("gllvm","glm","jmle", "glmnet"), each = B), levels = c("gllvm","glm","jmle", "glmnet")),
                         KL1 = c(KL_all_gllvm1, KL_all_glm1, KL_all_jmle1, KL_all_glmnet1),
                         time1 = c(time_all_gllvm1, time_all_glm1, time_all_jmle1, time_all_glmnet1),
                         KL2 = c(KL_all_gllvm2, KL_all_glm2, KL_all_jmle2, KL_all_glmnet2),
                         time2 = c(time_all_gllvm2, time_all_glm2, time_all_jmle2, time_all_glmnet2))

#Comparison between true and predicted counts
f_diff_gllvm1_all = rep(NA, B)
f_diff_gllvm2_all = rep(NA, B)
f_diff_glm1_all = rep(NA, B)
f_diff_glm2_all = rep(NA, B)
f_diff_jmle1_all = rep(NA, B)
f_diff_jmle2_all = rep(NA, B)
f_diff_glmnet1_all = rep(NA, B)
f_diff_glmnet2_all = rep(NA, B)

for (i in 1:B){
  ref_1 = norm(as.matrix(sim_counts_all[ , i, ]), type = "F")
  ref_2 = norm(as.matrix(sim_counts_all_2[ , i, ]), type = "F")
  load(file.path("gllvm_models", paste0("gllvm_sim_1_", i, ".RDATA")))
  f_gllvm1 = norm(pred_mu_gllvm1, type = "F")
  f_diff_gllvm1_all[i] = abs(f_gllvm1 - ref_1)
    
  load(file.path("gllvm_models", paste0("gllvm_sim_2_", i, ".RDATA")))
  f_gllvm2 = norm(pred_mu_gllvm2, type = "F")
  f_diff_gllvm2_all[i] = abs(f_gllvm2 - ref_2)

  load(file.path("glm_models", paste0("glm_sim_1_", i, ".RDATA")))
  f_glm1 = norm(pred_mu_glm1, type = "F")
  f_diff_glm1_all[i] = abs(f_glm1 - ref_1)

  load(file.path("glm_models", paste0("glm_sim_2_", i, ".RDATA")))
  f_glm2 = norm(pred_mu_glm2, type = "F")
  f_diff_glm2_all[i] = abs(f_glm2 - ref_2)

  load(file.path("jmle_models", paste0("jmle_sim_1_", i, ".RDATA")))
  f_jmle1 = norm(pred_mu_jmle1, type = "F")
  f_diff_jmle1_all[i] = abs(f_jmle1 - ref_1)
  
  load(file.path("jmle_models", paste0("jmle_sim_2_", i, ".RDATA")))
  f_jmle2 = norm(pred_mu_jmle2, type = "F")
  f_diff_jmle2_all[i] = abs(f_jmle2 - ref_2)

  load(file.path("glmnet_models", paste0("glmnet_sim_1_", i, ".RDATA")))
  f_glmnet1 = norm(pred_mu_glmnet1, type = "F")
  f_diff_glmnet1_all[i] = abs(f_glmnet1 - ref_1)

  load(file.path("glmnet_models", paste0("glmnet_sim_2_", i, ".RDATA")))
  f_glmnet2 = norm(pred_mu_glmnet2, type = "F")
  f_diff_glmnet2_all[i] = abs(f_glmnet2 - ref_2)
}

df = df %>% mutate(f_diff1 = c(f_diff_gllvm1_all, f_diff_glm1_all, f_diff_jmle1_all, f_diff_glmnet1_all),
              f_diff2 = c(f_diff_gllvm2_all, f_diff_glm2_all, f_diff_jmle2_all, f_diff_glmnet2_all))
  
sim_plot = function(y, ylab, title, ylim = NULL){
  g = ggplot(data = df, aes(x = method, y = {{y}}, color = method)) + 
  ylab(ylab) + xlab("") +
  ggtitle(title) + 
  guides(color = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(lwd = 0.5, fill = NA) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) + 
  theme_bw()
}

sim_log_plot = function(y, ylab, title, ylim = NULL){
  g = ggplot(data = df, aes(x = method, y = {{y}}, color = method)) + 
  ylab(ylab) + xlab("") +
  ggtitle(title) + 
  guides(color = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(lwd = 0.5, fill = NA) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log", labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)) + 
  theme_bw()
}

g = sim_plot(y = KL1, ylab = "KL Divergence (1 l.v.)", title = "KL Divergence for 1 latent variable", ylim = c(300, 1000))
print(g)
ggsave("figures/sim-KLD1.png", width = 4, height = 6)

g = sim_log_plot(y = time1, ylab = "Computation Time (s) (log-scaled)", title = "Computation time for 1 latent variable (s)")#, ylim = c(0, 40))
g
ggsave("figures/sim-time1.png", width = 4, height = 6)

g = sim_plot(y = KL2, ylab = "KL Divergence (2 l.v.)", title = "KL Divergence for 2 latent variables", ylim = c(450, 1000))
g
ggsave("figures/sim-KLD2.png", width = 4, height = 6)

g = sim_log_plot(y = time2, ylab = "Computation Time (s) (log-scaled)", title = "Computation time for 2 latent variable (s)")
g
ggsave("figures/sim-time2.png", width = 4, height = 6)

g = sim_plot(y = f_diff1, ylab = "Absolute Differences in Frobenius Norm", title = "|Frobenius Difference| for 1 latent variable")
g
ggsave("figures/sim-f_diff1.png", width = 4, height = 6)

g = sim_plot(y = f_diff2, ylab = "Absolute Differences in Frobenius Norm", title = "|Frobenius Difference| for 2 latent variables")
g
ggsave("figures/sim-f_diff2.png", width = 4, height = 6)
```

```{r GLLVM KL trimmed outliers for mean, sd}
)
```
